items.title: Max Financial Services reports massive profit growth of Rs 100 crore in Q2 FY26
items.description: Max Financial Services recorded a substantial rise in net profit during the second quarter to ₹100 crore. This marks a significant increase from ₹5.9 crore in the same period last year. The company owns an 80% stake in Axis Max Life, contributing to its financial growth. Additionally, its value of new business rose 21% year-on-year, reaching ₹1,180 crore in H1 FY27.

items.title: Cipla’s US recovery, biosimilar pipeline key to future growth prospects
items.description: Cipla's September-quarter earnings suffered due to a high base in its US business. The company reported sequential growth driven by its strong India business and branded prescription therapies. Recent approvals for respiratory products and a growing biosimilar pipeline bolster Cipla's optimism for future growth. Despite declining operating margins, the firm anticipates improvements supported by product launches. Cipla remains focused on evaluating inorganic opportunities to enhance its specialty portfolio.

items.title: HUL Q2 Results: Net profit rises 4% YoY to Rs 2,790 crore; Rs 19/share dividend declared
items.description: HUL Q2 Results: The company’s revenue from operations rose 15% year-on-year to Rs 18,226 crore in the quarter, compared with Rs 15,919 crore in the corresponding period last year.

items.title: Maruti Q2 net misses street view despite record quarterly sales
items.description: Maruti Suzuki's consolidated net profit fell by 26% in the fiscal second quarter to ₹2,466 crore. Revenue rose 26% to ₹53,355.5 crore, driven by record sales of 696,654 units. The company achieved 40.8% market share with strong demand for small cars and SUVs. Operating profit decreased due to increased input costs and lower other income.

items.title: Bajaj Auto Q2 net profit up 35% on strong exports, product mix
items.description: Bajaj Auto reported a 35% increase in standalone net profit for the September quarter. Revenue from operations rose to a record ₹20,003 crore, fueled by an increase in exports. The company also managed to counter rising input costs through strategic price adjustments and a richer product mix. Electric vehicle sales, including the Chetak scooter, contributed to the profitability amid varying performance in the domestic market.

items.title: Star Health and Allied Insurance reports 232% profit surge at Rs 264.4 crore
items.description: Star Health and Allied Insurance achieved a net profit of ₹264.4 crore for the September quarter of FY27. This profit reflects a 232% increase from ₹79.6 crore reported in the same quarter last year. The company’s claims ratio improved to 69%, showing a reduced claims burden compared to previous periods. For the first half of FY27, the insurer recorded a net profit of ₹814.6 crore. This figure exceeds the ₹517.

items.title: SBI Life posts 11% growth in Q2 net profit
items.description: SBI Life Insurance has unveiled an impressive 11% net profit growth year-on-year for the September 2026 quarter, alongside an 8.2% rise in net premium income. Looking ahead, the company recorded a robust 17% net profit increase for the first half of FY27 and anticipates ongoing growth in individual rated premium this financial year. Additionally, the improvement in SBI Life's solvency ratio further solidifies its strong financial standing.

items.title: L&T profit jumps 33% on strong order inflows
items.description: Larsen & Toubro reported a quarterly net profit increase of 33% amid strong order inflows and infrastructure spending. Revenue for the quarter rose 16% year-on-year, reaching ₹78,750 crore, driven by progress in various projects. The company secured orders worth ₹1,47,665 crore during the quarter, marking a 28% year-on-year growth. International orders accounted for 63% of total order inflow, showcasing the company's strong performance.

items.title: AWL Agri Business experiences 2% profit drop, emphasises growth in packaged food and exports
items.description: AWL Agri Business has reported a 2% decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Revenue from operations, however, increased by 26.1%, reaching ₹22,270 crore. The company's food and FMCG business saw significant growth, with a 32% year-on-year rise in revenue. AWL plans to focus on expanding its packaged food offerings and entering new markets. Additionally, the company aims to develop the pulses category, which presents attractive profit margins.

items.title: Vedanta Iron and Steel’s loss narrows on year in September quarter
items.description: In the September quarter, Vedanta Iron and Steel reported a consolidated loss of Rs 324 crore despite a decrease in expenses, which fell by more than 9% to Rs 3,129 crore due to various operational difficulties. The company produced 532,000 tonnes of steel, reflecting a year-on-year increase of 4%. This showcases a notable enhancement in financial metrics amidst persistent issues in the iron ore sector.

items.title: Adani-group owned ACC’s consolidated profit slumps 92% on year in September quarter
items.description: ACC reported a significant 92% decline in profit for the September quarter, attributed to lower sales volumes. The company’s profit stood at Rs 93 crore, a sharp drop from Rs 1,119 crore last year. Consolidated revenue also fell by over 5%, reflecting the impact of a supply agreement with Ambuja Cements. Total expenses increased by more than 2%, despite the drop in revenue during this period.

items.title: Vedanta Aluminium Q2 Results: Profit doubles to Rs 6,187 crore, revenue jumps 41%
items.description: Vedanta Aluminium’s Q2 FY27 net profit surged 105% to Rs 6,187 crore, driven by record production, higher sales and improved realisations. Revenue rose 41%, EBITDA increased 83%, and net debt declined Rs 3,090 crore sequentially.

items.title: Bandhan Bank Q2 profit jumps 5.6 times as asset quality improves
items.description: Bandhan Bank reported a five-fold rise in Q2 profit to Rs 622 crore, supported by lower provisions and improving asset quality. Net interest income grew 14%, margins strengthened, gross advances increased 13%, and deposits rose 9% year-on-year.

items.title: Meesho Q2 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 132 crore YoY, revenue rises 34%
items.description: Meesho’s Q2 FY27 net loss narrowed 67.8% to Rs 132.45 crore, while revenue surged 34.4% to Rs 4,131.58 crore. Rising user engagement, stronger merchandise value, improved contribution margins and festive-season demand supported growth amid elevated spending.

items.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 profit falls 24% despite record sales
items.description: Hyundai Motor India’s Q2 FY27 net profit fell 24% to Rs 1,196.2 crore as commodity costs pressured margins. Revenue rose 19% to Rs 20,696.1 crore, supported by record sales, stronger exports and upcoming vehicle launches.

items.title: Anant Raj Q2 Results: Profit rises 13% to Rs 156 crore
items.description: Anant Raj Ltd has demonstrated robust financial performance, with a 13 percent rise in consolidated net profits for the September quarter. The company's total income surged to Rs 678.95 crore, up from Rs 640.89 crore the previous year. For the first half of the year, net profit climbed to Rs 305.68 crore, compared to Rs 264.08 crore, signaling its strong standing in the Indian real estate sector.

items.title: Vedanta Aluminium quarterly profit more than doubles on high prices, record production
items.description: Vedanta Aluminium reported a significant increase in its quarterly profit, which more than doubled from the previous year. The company's consolidated net profit rose to 51.67 billion rupees for the quarter ending September 30. Revenue from operations also increased by 40% during the same period, driven by elevated aluminium prices. Aluminium production hit a record of 649,000 metric tons, up 5% from last year.

items.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 Results: Profit surges 41% to Rs 1,630 crore; co plans to raise Rs 5,00O crore via QIP
items.description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company has reported an impressive 41 percent surge in net profit for the second quarter, marking Rs 1,630 crore, up from Rs 1,155 crore the previous year. Their total income significantly increased to Rs 9,367 crore, primarily fueled by rising interest income. Additionally, the company's gross non-performing assets improved to 3.29 percent, signaling enhanced asset quality.

items.title: TVS Motor Q2 Results: Profit jumps 52% YoY to Rs 1,377 crore; revenue rises 44%
items.description: TVS Motor Company reported a 52% rise in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,377 crore, with revenue up 44%. Record sales, electric two-wheeler growth and strategic acquisitions boosted performance, while shares gained 2.52% on the NSE.

items.title: Info Edge Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 93% YoY to Rs 334 crore, revenue rises 13%; co declares Rs 3/share interim dividend
items.description: Info Edge reported a sharp year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit due to a large exceptional gain in the previous year, while revenue and operating profit grew. Recruitment, 99acres and matchmaking businesses recorded healthy growth, alongside AI-led expansion.

items.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 Results: Standalone profit falls 24% YoY to Rs 1,189 crore, but revenue rises 18%
items.description: Hyundai Motors India has reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,189 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting a notable decrease of 24% compared to Rs 1,570 crore during the same period last year. However, their operational revenue has grown to Rs 20,191 crore, representing an 18% increase from Rs 17,061 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. This performance illustrates the company's resilience amidst shifting market conditions.

items.title: Vedanta Q2 Results: Profit zooms 78% YoY to Rs 6,202 crore; revenue surges 57%
items.description: Vedanta Q2 Results: Vedanta Ltd reported a 78% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 6,202 crore in the September quarter, while revenue increased 57% to Rs 26,356 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 9,938 crore, with margins improving to 60%. Higher commodity prices and increased production supported earnings, while net debt fell by Rs 4,624 crore to Rs 3,675 crore during the quarter.

items.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results: Revenue spikes 75% YoY to Rs 37,216 crore,  profit at Rs 1,492 crore
items.description: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results 2026: Adani Enterprises has reported a 55% drop in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY27, with figures reaching Rs 1,492 crore compared to Rs 3,304 crore from the previous year. Conversely, operational revenue surged by 75%, hitting Rs 37,216 crore. This stark contrast is notable due to the previous year's inflated profits, driven by exceptional gains totaling Rs 3,583 crore, highlighting a dramatic shift in financial performance.

items.title: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 17% YoY to Rs 3,622 crore; revenue up 24%
items.description: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Adani Ports reported a 17% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 3,622 crore, while revenue grew 24% to Rs 11,340 crore. The company raised its FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance by Rs 1,000 crore each and increased its capex guidance by Rs 3,000 crore, citing strong first-half performance.
